name: Black Bean Tacos

ingredients.name: black beans
ingredients.original: 2 x 400 g tins black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the onion and capsicum over medium heat for 8 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin and smoked paprika and stir for a minute until fragrant.
Add the black beans with a splash of water and cook for 8 minutes, mashing about a third of them against the pan so the mixture holds together. Season well.
Warm the tortillas one at a time in a dry pan for 20 seconds a side, stacking them under a clean tea towel as you go.
Fill each tortilla with the beans, then top with cheese, sour cream and coriander.
Serve with the lime wedges to squeeze over.
